message.reasoning: We need to navigate to temporary directory. In Unix, temp dir is /tmp. We can use cd? There's no cd tool but we can use pwd to see current. But we can't change directory? There's no tool for changing directory. But maybe we can specify path in ls? The ls tool has path? It doesn't have path param. So we can't list /tmp unless we are already there. But we can use find with path? find has path param. But listing all files including hidden? find can list all. But we want to list all files in /tmp including hidden. Use find path="/tmp" name=None. That will return all items. Let's do that.
